description: Convert an uploaded file (file_base64) or public URL: CSV and XLSX become JSON rows per sheet; text PDFs become text per page. Up to 5 MB decoded, 20,000 rows per sheet; no OCR, PDF table grids or schema extraction. No account or API key; free within the shared daily limit. Files are sent to Decant, processed in memory and not stored. URL fetching honours robots.txt. Send exactly one input; local files need not be published. For a large file, pass limit (and offset) to page the rows, since many hosts show only part of a long tool result. Raw-upload HTTP is also available.

file_base64.description: File bytes encoded as standard padded base64 (up to 5 MB decoded); not a path or data URL. Use instead of url.

filename.description: Optional filename with .csv, .xlsx or .pdf extension for type detection; not a filesystem path

limit.description: At most this many rows per sheet; row_count stays the total and next_offset is where the next page starts. Omit for every row

offset.description: First row of each sheet to return (0-based), to page a large file

sheet.description: Only this XLSX sheet, if specified

url.description: Public HTTP(S) file URL; omit when sending file_base64

name: convert_document
title: Convert CSV, XLSX or text PDF to JSON
